RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel reflects poor diversity practices and potential affinity bias, but it is not proof of discrimination. For a head of risk modelling, regulatory affairs experience and executive presence are crucial leadership requirements that often outweigh purely technical credentials like a PhD. 

Raising gender bias now, especially before receiving feedback, will trigger defensiveness, burn bridges, and harm your reputation in a niche industry. Two weeks is also standard corporate HR timing. 

Follow up politely on your feedback request to understand what skills to strengthen, rather than challenging the panel composition.
